label: Model access
definition: Announced agreement permitting model access; not proof access occurred.

label: Evaluation
definition: Named evaluator performed a model-specific exercise.

label: Joint evaluation
definition: Named evaluators conducted a shared exercise; not programme co-membership.

label: Deployment
definition: An identified institution reports deploying or using the named provider system, possibly through intermediaries.

label: Procurement
definition: Officially announced award. Ceiling is not expenditure; exact legal awardee remains unresolved when announcement only names brand.

label: Formal cooperation
definition: Named parties enter a defined memorandum or research agreement; implementation separately documented.

label: Code participation
definition: Administrator confirms signature for specified voluntary code chapters; not regulatory compliance.

label: Tool availability
definition: Institution documents named tool available for execution; not observed utilization or direct contract.

label: Contested use
definition: Dated dispute over conditions for use of a named provider system; no dependency inferred.
